name: corpus
description: Corpus and Steady — two products, one monorepo. Web and mobile clients for each.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @corpus/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @corpus/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @corpus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:steady-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @corpus/core && npm run test:steady
scripts.dev:steady-web: npm run build:steady-core && npm run dev -w @steady/web
scripts.dev:steady-mobile: npm run build:steady-core && npm run start -w @steady/mobile
scripts.build:steady: npm run build:steady-core && npm run build -w @steady/web
scripts.test:steady: npm run build:steady-core && npm run test -w @steady/core
